Atoms have a tiny, dense, positively charged nucleus

prompt: What varies between different isotopes of the same element?
explanation: The number of neutrons — isotopes have the same number of protons.

prompt: Explain why reactivity decreases down Group 7 (the halogens), in terms of electronic structure.
indicativeContent: Group 7 elements react by gaining one electron to complete their outer shell
Going down the group, atoms get bigger — the outer shell is further from the nucleus
This means the attraction between the nucleus and an incoming electron is weaker
It becomes harder to gain an extra electron, so reactivity decreases down the group
A full-marks answer links atomic size to the strength of nuclear attraction, not just states the trend
